goal: Publish one validated canonical rewrite per source transformation key with durable source fallback and crash recovery.
acceptance_tests: Two worker processes contend safely for one transformation; stale leases cannot publish.
Rewrite preserves technical values, warnings, block order, evidence and asset positions.
Missing, unchanged or rejected rewrite retains an explicit source/pending state.
Crash and restart resume from persisted source/model result without duplicate publication.
Warm completed reads make zero provider or model calls.
Changed source/version creates an immutable revision of the same article identity.
An explicit unchanged-source refresh reuses the existing exhausted transformation owner, retains source provenance, and never resets its retry budget or assigns its unique key to another job.
forbidden_scope: Changing the autonomy policy or weakening required checks
Publishing secrets or private source payloads
Editing paths outside the assigned scope
Changing the requested gpt-6.1-sol / medium / Fast execution profile or silently falling back to another model or tier

compatibility.api: Preserve existing consumers with additive versioned fields; run compatibility checks.
compatibility.events: Preserve event identity and make duplicate delivery idempotent.
compatibility.schema: Forward-only additive migrations with clean and upgrade verification; no destructive edits to historical migrations.
